name: Fyssen Foundation Post-doctoral Study Grant
amount: Up to EUR 45,000/year (hosting, living and health insurance)
other_rules: French or foreign researchers aged 35 or under at the closing date
PhD within the last 2 years or viva by 31 December of the application year
foreign PhDs go to French labs, French PhDs go abroad
no more than 3 months in the host lab by 1 September
notes: Ethology, paleontology, archaeology, anthropology, psychology, epistemology, logic and nervous-system sciences. 2026 deadline 31 Mar 2026 (from a third-party listing). 12 or 24 months.
